extension.summary: Unofficial Kodi Live TV and DVR client for Dispatcharr
extension.description: Connects Kodi's Live TV / PVR features directly to a self-hosted Dispatcharr instance: live channels, EPG, and DVR (scheduled and series recordings) using Dispatcharr's own backend, not a third-party compatibility layer. This is an unofficial, community-maintained addon; it is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by the Dispatcharr project or by Kodi/Team Kodi.
